outcome: The native CLI pin stops being a compiled trap: admission becomes policy - exact mode preserves today's byte-for-byte closure, minor mode admits a binary whose self-reported version satisfies the pinned major.minor range - while receipts stay exact always because the digest of the binary that actually ran lands durably per dispatch, the shipped claude pin moves to the live 2.1.241 so a main-built binary stops compiling a server-side-dead CLI, and a dead pin refuses at admission with a named code instead of burning tries as opaque transport failures.

spontaneous-exit reclassification and the refusal Kind vocabulary (S4's seam; this slice adds one named admission refusal, not a taxonomy)
init-time pin detection and drivers.json authoring (cmd/sworn init writes pins from the host today and is unchanged)
codex pin policy semantics beyond compiling cleanly (the claude pin is the live-fire case; minor mode for codex may land inert behind the same knob)

acceptance.text: Admission is policy, default unchanged: NativeAdapterConfig (internal/driver/native.go:46-59) gains an optional pin-mode field (omitempty, so every existing drivers.json document stays byte-identical under the canonical round-trip at config.go:194-196 and no ConfigurationDigest moves for configs that do not declare it), and validateNativeConfig (native.go:197-240) consults it: absent or "exact" preserves today's four exact comparisons per family (codex :204-210, claude :211-217, NATIVE_NOT_CERTIFIED on mismatch); "minor" admits a CLI whose self-reported version satisfies the pinned major.minor range while the credential-target check stays exact. The pinned constants move to the live claude CLI (ClaudeCLIVersion 2.1.234 -> 2.1.241, ClaudeCLIDigest sha256:3473601e... -> sha256:0771bd86..., native.go:13-14 - the operator patch archived in the R4 ops home is the seed). Pinned by unit tests over absent/exact/minor modes including an in-range and an out-of-range version.

Receipts stay exact, always: today nothing durable records the digest of the binary that actually executed - openPinnedExecutable (internal/driver/process_linux.go:555-586) hashes the running fd only to compare against identity.Digest (EXECUTABLE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH :579) and discards the value, and the sealed handoff carries no adapter or binary digest (submission.go:503-509; PermissionDescriptor's adapter_config_digest at :356 never leaves internal/driver). After this slice the executed CLI's digest reaches a durable per-dispatch surface the journal already persists (the attempt observation is the candidate carrier) in BOTH modes, so minor-mode admission never weakens attestation: an auditor can read exactly which bytes ran even when the range admitted them. Pinned by a test that dispatches through the native lane and finds the executed digest on the durable record.

A dead pin refuses at admission instead of burning tries: the 2.1.234 deprecation was certified-and-dead simultaneously - checkCertify returns native_preflight_not_required after a version-output compare only (native.go:327-341), and a server-side-dead CLI then burns dispatch tries as PROVIDER_TRANSPORT_FAILED because the auth-exit branch is production-dead (nativeAuthExitCodes is an empty map, native.go:38, so nativeSpontaneousExitFailure at native_linux.go:2333-2349 falls through). After this slice a bounded, side-effect-free dispatch-time liveness check distinguishes 'the pinned binary cannot transact' and refuses with a named admission code before the try budget burns; the probe result is journaled. Mechanism is design freedom (a bounded CLI liveness run is acceptable); the pinned outcome is the named refusal plus zero burned tries. Pinned by a test with a scripted dead CLI.

constraints: Exact receipts are non-negotiable: no mode, knob, or failure path may ship a dispatch whose executed-binary digest is absent from the durable record while minor mode is declared.

Default behavior is byte-for-byte today's: a config without the new field admits and refuses exactly as before this slice, and the new field is omitempty so existing canonical documents and their digests are untouched.

Certification evidence stays a soft prior in minor mode - it biases nothing at admission and never becomes a gate across the range (the capability-based-selection ruling's hard-gate/soft-prior split, applied to pins).

Test fixtures ride along honestly: exactClaudeBinary (native_linux_test.go:27-30) points at a 2.1.208 host path so every claude exact-CLI test skips today - refresh it with the pin bump; the w8 corpus's deliberate admission bypass (w8_shared_corpus_linux_test.go:1173-1183 constructs the adapter directly) must keep working; the config round-trip fixture (config_test.go:305-357) builds from the constants and must stay pin-consistent.
Check evidence belongs in the submission's checks field, never in files added to the repository.
